bio.text: Ace Parsi, a Democrat and community organizer, was a candidate in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary for West Virginia's 2nd Congressional District.
According to West Virginia Watch, he was born in Iran and his family immigrated to the United States when he was 8 years old.

Parsi and his wife moved to West Virginia, where she was raised, about ten years before the interview, and he served as coalition engagement director for iCivics before leaving the role to run for Congress.

sources.title: In race for WV's 2nd House of Representatives district, three Dems vie for chance to unseat Moore
